notes: Three fixes. (1) Only 'Hard no' removes a theme from the games — 'Not for me' is the soft refusal and now changes nothing, and 'Hard no' is a new fifth answer. (2) The 'who leads' card is scored as a compatibility PAIR, so 'I lead' + 'they follow' is a match and 'we both want to lead' is the failure state. (3) Card ids are content-derived instead of positional, so a version push can no longer renumber stored answers, and an interrupted Limits round survives a refresh.
